title: Tour: Social Planner
blurb: See where to write, schedule and track posts for all your social pages.

steps.title: Open Social Planner
steps.body: Click **Social Planner**. This is home for every post you send to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and Google Business.

steps.title: Start a post here
steps.body: **+ New Post** is where every post begins. Its menu also has options to upload a spreadsheet of posts or let AI write one for you.

steps.title: Your Planner
steps.body: The **Planner** shows everything in one place: drafts, scheduled posts, published posts and any that failed. You can see it as a calendar or a list.

steps.title: Reusable content
steps.body: **Content** is where recurring posts and saved content live, so you can edit a whole series in one go.

steps.title: Accounts and settings
steps.body: The **Settings** tab (inside Social Planner, not the main menu) is where you connect a new social account or fix one that has dropped off.
steps.tip: **Statistics** sits next to it and shows reach and engagement for each account.

steps.title: What to do first
steps.body: If your pages are connected, write your first post. Next: try **Create and schedule a social post** from the Guide.
